games.name: [MEMORIES] AOT: Shattered Battlegrounds
games.desc:
This game is a sandbox battleground game based off the anime "Attack On Titan". The games visual style is meant to be blocky. You can gain money by taking down mindless titans. You can use money to buy serums to eat other titan shifters or buy clan rerolls/outfits. The game currently supports PC and console although it is highly recommended to play on PC. Typing /reset will respawn you.
(USE CODE !3850likes FOR REWARDS, NEXT CODE AT 4000 LIKES)

(DATA WILL NOT SAVE IN A PRIVATE SERVER)

Premium players get 1.5x cash

If you'd like to become a titan shifter there is a random chance of you becoming one, or you can eat one with a serum.

The game is still a WIP, if you got any questions or suggestions please join the communications server

[PC CONTROLS]

Q/E Grapple
R - Equip Weapon
T - Equip Blades (Eldia)
F - Use Serum/Shift/Unshift
V - Family Emote
B - Sit
N - Salute
M - Hood up/down
X - Buy TS/Grenades
H - Spawn Horse
Left Control - Toggle Shiftlock

Credits to Reiuk
